summary: Initialize the instance by setting the payment provider and zeroing authorized and refunded totals.
inputs: provider (str): Payment provider identifier; defaults to 'internal-wallet'.
outputs: self.provider (str): Instance attribute set to the provided provider value.
self.authorized_total_cents (int): Instance attribute initialized to 0 representing total authorized amount in cents.
self.refunded_total_cents (int): Instance attribute initialized to 0 representing total refunded amount in cents.
side_effects: self.authorized_total_cents (int): Instance attribute initialized to 0 representing total authorized amount in cents.
self.provider (str): Instance attribute set to the provided provider value.
self.refunded_total_cents (int): Instance attribute initialized to 0 representing total refunded amount in cents.
